summary: Antares Strategic Credit Fund, a non-traded BDC, filed a Form 8-K disclosing a routine quarterly distribution of $0.1905 per share and a portfolio/NAV update. The fund also reported receiving approximately $7.1 million in subscriptions under its continuous private placement, with shares offered at NAV ($24.92 as of June 30, 2026). No strategic transaction, tender, spin-off, or material restructuring is involved. The filing is standard BDC reporting with no special situation elements, thus classified as 'None'.
